purpose: RESEARCH ONLY (Phase 3, local). geom_q078_v1 (q = 0.78) stays active; nothing is promoted.

A_properties.toleranceNote: 1.0 for the integer-rounded production dispatch (GEOM_78, KTC), 1e-6 otherwise; homogeneity tolerance scales with k

definition.breakEvenRawMultiple: raw total (as a multiple of the star) an even package of n equal pieces needs for its adjusted value to equal the star's; 1.0 = no premium
definition.secondPieceMarginalWeight: (gap([S, r*S], [S]) - gap([S], [S])) / (r*S): the share of a 2nd piece of relative size r that is credited

C_realExamples.convention: A = side giving fewer pieces; gapA = adjusted A minus adjusted B (positive favours A); level = fairness_bands_v1 on adjusted totals

cases.case: IDP star vs 2 IDP starters (~55% each)
IDP star vs 3 IDP starters (~40% each)

fairnessSample.population: assets drawn uniformly from the top 500 board values; 1-3 v 1-7 pieces (more-pieces side >= fewer); raw gap <= 25% of the larger raw side

finderReplay.context: context-free only (use_team_context=False): roster capacity / posture are box-local, so forced-drop and posture effects are excluded by design
finderReplay.harness: scripts/package_model_finder_replay.py (Phase 2), candidate installed in-process behind package_model._geom_pair and always restored
